title: Add a VIXEN light gate for generated-code checks
body: The lane-mandated command bash tools/check-content-codegen.sh failed with exit 127 because that script does not exist in VIXEN. The generation guards live as 22 ALL targets in VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt. We recovered by running the default CMake build through the queue. Add a documented VIXEN light command that invokes the complete check target set.

title: Add a shared WSL Vulkan runtime environment for GPU tests
body: The queued GPU invocation with VK_ICD_FILENAMES and VK_LAYER_PATH but no LD_LIBRARY_PATH failed at vkCreateInstance with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER (-9). ldd showed libxcb-keysyms.so.1 unresolved in the Dozen ICD. Exporting the VulkanLoader, Mesa Dozen, and VIXEN windowing dependency directories in LD_LIBRARY_PATH let the tests reach their bodies. Provide one documented VIXEN GPU-test launcher that sources this runtime setup.

title: Make the native default build resolve its WSL codegen launcher
body: The queued native default build failed before compiling because Ninja reported C:/Windows/System32/wsl.exe missing while generating codegen/checks/octreeconfig_check.stamp. The native vixen_editor target build succeeded, and the complete WSL build ran the generation graph. Fix the native preset or codegen launcher path so the default native build can execute its ALL checks.

title: Make VIXEN MSVC builds safe from min and max macros
body: The queued native vixen_editor build failed in AppFlowChannel.cpp:77 with MSVC C2589/C2059 because Windows min/max macros expanded std::max. Wrapping the call as (std::max)(...) allowed the target to build. Add one project-wide macro policy or equivalent portability guard so native-only witnesses do not require per-call source patches.

title: Provision the assigned native checkout before dispatch
body: The dispatch named /mnt/c/vixen-native/shellasync0 as the required Windows checkout, but the path was absent. We had to clone the lane into that path and provision its private presets and caches before any native witness could run. Make the assigned native checkout provisioning part of lane setup so the native gate is immediately runnable.

title: Validate the native editor fixture path in the performance runner
body: The first queued native editor perf run passed BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.vxd from the checkout root, but the asset lives under VIXEN/BuiltAssets; the editor failed to load the document and wrote no frame rows. Updating the runner to pass VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.vxd produced the baseline CSV. Provide a canonical native measurement runner that checks its fixture path before launching.

title: Align the queued VIXEN build command with the configured cache directory
body: The queued command cmake --build build failed with Error: could not load cache because this lane's preset stores the configured Linux cache under build/wsl. Running queued cmake --build build/wsl is the supported working route. Keep the dispatch recipe and preset cache location aligned so source edits do not require a manual path correction.

title: Make native look-dev capture runner root-configurable for lane checkouts
body: The featureab run-batch.ps1 hardcodes C:\vixen-native\featureab as both the executable and config root, while this dispatch assigns C:\vixen-native\shellasync0. Reproducing the four-state, 192-frame s_shell_normals capture required a handwritten PowerShell process runner that reset VIXEN_* variables and isolated outputs under the assigned checkout. Parameterize the input root, executable, and output root so lanes can invoke the same canonical capture protocol without recreating it.
